Notice for the post of Staff Nurse
Tuesday, 14 May 2024
3545 Hits
NOTICE
Applications received for the post of Staff Nurse have been scrutinized on the basis of criterion mentioned in the advertisement and finalization by the Scrutiny committee. Following applicants have been found to eligible & not eligible in accordance with the eligibility criteria as mentioned in the advertisement.
In case if any of the applicant is not satisfied with the reasons for ineligibility he/she may submit his/her representation, supported by documents as evidence. Please contact MS Office (Personal Section) before 20th May 2024, up to 5.00 PM. No requests shall be entertained beyond the specified period. Representations without supporting documents will not be entertained.  Eligible candidates will have written examination on 25
th
May 2024 at 10.00 AM in the Examination Hall, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram. After written examination, the qualified candidates will be invited for the interview on 27
th
May 2024. The list of qualified candidates will be displayed in our website and notice board.
Medical Superintendent
Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram

Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
